title: Grateful Dead Live at Polo Field, Golden Gate Park on 1969-05-07
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Energetic 5‑7‑69 Golden Gate Park show with standout Good Lovin' and Dark Star, captured on a decent audience recording that needs a little EQ
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the free‑park performance’s creative jams – especially Jerry’s lead vocal on Good Lovin', a smoking Dark Star and an adventurous Uncle/Other One sequence – while noting the tape isn’t as crisp as later soundboard releases and could benefit from some EQ. Overall the show is considered tight, high‑energy, and underrated despite occasional comments about a looser, “blitzed” feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.2, strong praise for musical performance and only moderate recording complaints; many detailed positive comments give confidence in the assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound not as sharp as later era recordings, described as an A‑grade with some EQ needs and occasional drop‑outs; overall acceptable for a 1969 outdoor audience tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A surprising set that breaks the usual DS‑SS‑11‑LL pattern, featuring long jammed sections and unusual song pairings that keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads Good Lovin' on vocals, plays petal steel, acoustic and electric guitars; tone described as classic SG and tight throughout.
